evidence.ACL: Near complete to complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) at its more distal fibers.
evidence.MCL: Grade 1 sprain of the medial collateral ligament (MCL).
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Small vertical tear at the peripheral aspect of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, compatible with a meniscal ramp lesion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Small complex tear at the posterior root of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness chondrosis at the medial patellar facet.
evidence.Contusion: severe osseous contusion at the sulcus terminalis at the lateral femoral condyle.
evidence.Fracture: Osteochondral impaction injury at the posterolateral femoral condyle
